name: AmchoPlast
brief: A placental membrane wound covering with its amnion, intermediate layer, and chorion structure retained.
notes: Material & format
A sterile dehydrated human placental membrane allograft. The manufacturer describes AmchoPlast as a natural biological wound cover.
Handling
Store in a clean, dry environment at room temperature and follow the expiration date and current instructions supplied with the product.
Before ordering
Confirm the exact product name and dimensions. AmchoPlast and other Cellution product names should not be treated as interchangeable.

name: Membrane Wrap Hydro
brief: A hydrated, dual-layer amniotic membrane that serves as a protective wound covering.
notes: Material & format
Two layers of amnion in a hydrated format. Membrane Wrap Hydro is distinct from Membrane Wrap–Amniotic Hydro.
Practice consideration
Review the current packaging, available sizes, handling instructions, and documentation requirements with your clinical team.
Texas Medicaid resources
Ask us to review Q4290 for the specific plan, provider type, setting, and date of service. A fee-schedule entry does not establish coverage or guarantee payment.

name: Activate Matrix
brief: A full-thickness placental-derived allograft for use as a wound covering.
notes: Material & format
Includes the amniotic and chorionic membranes and the intermediate layer of the placenta.
Size options
The manufacturer lists 2 × 2, 2 × 4, 4 × 4, and 4 × 8 cm formats. Confirm current availability before ordering.
Clinical review
Use the current product instructions to evaluate intended use, preparation, orientation, and application for the individual patient.

name: Palisade
brief: A dual-membrane placental allograft with amnion and chorion in one wound covering.
notes: Material & format
A dehydrated placental membrane combining amnion and chorion. This composition differs from single-layer Sentry and full-thickness Activate.
Size options
The manufacturer lists 2 × 2, 2 × 4, 4 × 4, and 4 × 8 cm formats.
Before use
Review the product-specific package insert for donor screening, handling, and application information.

name: Sentry SL
brief: A single-layer amniotic membrane allograft designed as a biological wound covering.
notes: Material & format
Dehydrated human amnion in a thin single-layer format.
Size options
The manufacturer lists 2 × 2, 2 × 4, 4 × 4, and 4 × 8 cm formats.
Clinical review
Consider labeled use, the wound presentation, and the current instructions rather than selecting a product by layer count alone.

name: Membrane Wrap
brief: A dual-layer amniotic allograft used as a protective wound covering.
notes: Material & format
Human amnion-amnion tissue allograft supplied as a membrane.
Product family
Compare the standard membrane with the hydrated Hydro format and the amnion-chorion-amnion composition of Tri-Membrane Wrap.
Before ordering
Review the current manufacturer size list and product-specific instructions. Format and availability vary across the family.

name: Tri-Membrane Wrap
brief: A three-layer placental allograft for protective wound coverage.
notes: Material & format
Combines amnion, chorion, and amnion in a membrane sheet.
Clinical consideration
Layer composition is one product characteristic. Patient assessment, labeled use, handling, and available evidence also inform selection.
Before ordering
Confirm the current size list and product-specific instructions with the manufacturer or our team.

name: XCell Amnio Matrix
brief: A lyophilized amniotic membrane wound covering, available through New Horizon Medical Solutions.
notes: Material & format
A dry amniotic membrane with a flexible, opaque appearance described in the product literature.
Product identity
XCell Amnio Matrix and Xcellerate have different product names and ordering details. Confirm the exact product and size on every order.
Documentation
Request the current package insert, size list, and handling information before use.

name: PalinGen Membrane
brief: A chorion-free amniotic tissue allograft used as a biological wound covering.
notes: Material & format
Human amnion supplied as an air-dried, sterile membrane. The manufacturer describes it as resorbable and chorion-free.
Ordering
Rectangular and circular formats are listed. Confirm the exact membrane variant; dual-layer and hydrated products have their own specifications.
Clinical review
Review current instructions for the selected product and the intended wound application.

name: APIS
brief: A wound matrix combining collagen and Mānuka honey in a soft sheet format.
notes: Material & format
A collagen-derived matrix with Mānuka honey. Confirm the current formulation and instructions in the manufacturer documentation.
Read the evidence
Explore the product-specific clinical publications, including the study in Mohs surgical defects, alongside study populations and limitations.
Before ordering
Confirm the selected size, handling requirements, and application instructions. APIS and VERIS are distinct products.

name: Microlyte SAM
brief: A fully synthetic antimicrobial matrix that conforms to the wound surface.
notes: Material & format
A bioresorbable synthetic polymer matrix containing ionic and metallic silver.
Clinical review
Manufacturer labeling covers several chronic, surgical, and traumatic wound categories. Review the exact indications and current instructions.
Evidence & use
Separate laboratory antimicrobial findings from clinical outcomes. The evidence library links the available product-specific research.

name: Microlyte PainGuard
brief: A synthetic antimicrobial matrix with lidocaine, distinct from standard Microlyte.
notes: Material & format
Combines the synthetic antimicrobial matrix platform with lidocaine HCl.
Product distinction
PainGuard contains lidocaine. Review contraindications, precautions, product size, and current labeling for the specific patient.
Clinical resources
Review manufacturer information and the evidence library before establishing a practice protocol.

name: Myriad Matrix
brief: An extracellular matrix bioscaffold available in multiple sheet configurations.
notes: Material & format
A soft tissue bioscaffold based on AROA ECM. Sheet formats include different layer counts and dimensions.
Clinical scope
Manufacturer indications include soft tissue repair or reinforcement and management of a range of wounds. Review the exact product instructions.
Ordering
Confirm the selected formulation, layer count, and size. Availability through our supplier network may differ from the full manufacturer catalog.

name: Resolve Matrix
brief: An acellular collagen wound dressing derived from porcine peritoneum.
notes: Material & format
A thin, flexible acellular matrix. Manufacturer materials distinguish dry and hydrated formats.
Clinical review
Read the current indications for topical wound management and the instructions for the exact format selected.
Before ordering
Confirm dimensions, hydration state, current availability, and product-specific documentation.

name: Interfyl
brief: A human connective tissue matrix with flowable and particulate formats.
notes: Material & format
A placental-derived human connective tissue matrix. Flowable and particulate presentations have different preparation and ordering details.
Product review
Compare the selected format, amount, handling, and labeled use with your clinical requirements.
Clinical resources
The evidence library brings available regulatory, product, and clinical references together for further review.

name: XCelliStem
brief: A particulate wound product based on a blend of extracellular matrix materials.
notes: Material & format
A fine wound powder produced using the StemSys multi-tissue platform.
Clinical review
Review the product-specific indications and application instructions before considering its place in the care pathway.
Evidence
Read the available clinical reports in context; case reports and case series answer different questions from comparative trials.

name: UltraMIST
brief: Ultrasound therapy delivered through a non-contact saline mist.
notes: Technology
A low-frequency ultrasound system using non-contact fluid delivery to the treatment site.
Practice planning
Consider staff training, treatment setup, disposable supplies, and workflow alongside clinical suitability.
Resources
The manufacturer provides instructions for use and published references. Review product-specific patient considerations and contraindications.

name: Arobella Qoustic
brief: An ultrasound-assisted system for wound debridement and cleansing.
notes: Technology
The Qoustic Wound Therapy System uses an ultrasonic generator and handpiece with irrigation.
Practice planning
Review device configuration, instruments, staff training, and the labeled contact or non-contact techniques for the selected system.
Resources
Manufacturer materials include cleared indications, specifications, and a product catalog. Use the current instructions for clinical decisions.

name: MicroDoc
brief: A compact single-use negative pressure wound therapy system.
notes: Technology
A small portable control unit used with the matching dressing system.
Practice planning
Plan patient instruction, dressing selection, follow-up, and troubleshooting using current manufacturer guidance.
Product resources
The manufacturer provides specifications, manuals, and care resources. Review the current model and compatible components before use.

name: ActiGraft
brief: An autologous approach using a clot prepared from the patient’s own blood.
notes: Approach
A point-of-care system for preparing an autologous whole blood clot dressing.
Confirm the system
ActiGraft systems and versions have different instructions and components. Confirm the exact system supplied before training or use.
Read the evidence
Review the available clinical trials, populations, endpoints, and limitations in the evidence library.

name: Surgical allografts
brief: Bring the product, its labeled use, and your OR workflow into the same review.
notes: Product-specific review
Confirm the exact allograft brand and composition before evaluating a surgical application. The linked AmCoreMatrix manufacturer resource describes amnion, intermediate layer, and chorion.
OR planning
Discuss storage, preparation, instrumentation, staff training, and product-specific handling with our team.
Documentation
Request the current IFU and regulatory documentation. Review coverage and facility billing separately for the actual procedure and site of service.

name: Peptide catalog
brief: Review the catalog, available channels, and product-specific regulatory information.

name: Exosomes & birth tissue
brief: Review the scientific and regulatory context before discussing product availability.

name: Medical supplies
brief: Bring your facility’s supply requirements into one practical conversation.

name: Ovena Health
brief: Practical wound care and compression supplies for care beyond the clinic.
